card.name: Commas in side-effect lists, word-internal spots
card.fires_on: Fires on the comma after "anxiety" in lists of adverse effects, and partway through a few specific words: "inextricably" (at "extr"), "hypersensitivity" (at "ensitivity") and "dissociative".

modes.label: Comma after anxiety
modes.description: A comma or "and" inside a list of neurologic or skin side effects, especially right after "anxiety".

modes.description: The "extr" piece in "inextricably" in phrases like "inextricably linked".
